decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy is central to the firm's announced psychiatric care direction and was elevated to the home page in 2024, so the firm is publicly committed to it and would attribute any weak uptake to temporary start-up causes.

The senior living counseling service has been featured on the home page in both years, a visible and sustained commitment that fits the firm's core residential care mission and that management would feel obliged to justify by continuing.

The sheltered workshop retail shop received more prominence in 2024 and ties directly to the firm's established workshop operations, so the investment and public commitment favor persistence even if sales disappoint.

The meal delivery service is new, has had little investment, and is only mentioned on the website, which leaves it more exposed, but it fits the senior care direction and early results can still be blamed on its recent launch.
